name: chile-data-protection-api
description: Build developer-ready Chilean personal-data API workflows with recommended defaults and functional runtime controls.

interface.longDescription: Audit, design, or implement Chilean personal-data API capabilities against the complete amended framework effective 1 December 2026, with a complete repository-first target design, exact runtime changes, practical defaults, and selectable security postures. Audit mode does not run project tests by default. Legal source refresh is opt-in. This engineering aid does not provide legal advice or certify compliance.
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit or implement a complete repository-first Chilean personal-data API solution against the amended framework effective 1 December 2026. Reuse existing mechanisms and give exact routes, jobs, data changes, security controls, and tests.
